description:
AP-1: the extractor's short company summary, built from pages on the job posting's
domain when the company is not in the curated list. Briefs show it labeled
"auto-generated". It is far smaller than a CompanyProfile and never replaces one.

interview_process_notes.description: What the pages say about the hiring process. Empty when they say nothing.
interview_process_notes.title: Interview Process Notes

sources.description: URLs of the pages the summary is based on.
sources.title: Sources

summary.description: A few sentences on the company and the role.
summary.title: Summary

values_mentioned.description: Values or principles the pages name, in the company's words.
values_mentioned.title: Values Mentioned

title: AutoProfileSummary
